pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to make new document with properties {document theme:theme "Bold Color"}' -e 'tell application "Keynote" to set the object text of the default body item of the current slide of the front document to "Lecture 5"' -e 'tell application "Keynote" to set the object text of the default title item of the current slide of the front document to "Image Transforms"'
instruction: I am using the current template from the last lecture to create slides for the next lecture. Help me change Lecture 5 to Lecture 6, and the title to "Image Enhancement".
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default title item of the current slide of the front document' 2>/dev/null | awk '{$1=$1};1' | grep -q "^Image Enhancement$" && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default body item of the current slide of the front document' 2>/dev/null | awk '{$1=$1};1' | grep -q "^Lecture 6$" && echo "True" || echo "False"

osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default title item of the current slide of the front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Image Enhancement" && echo "True" || echo "False"
osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to get the object text of the default body item of the current slide of the front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Lecture 6" && echo "True" || echo "False"
